headline: Transfers of $157,000 and $220,000 from Salary Reserve to various accounts, including Police Salaries.
summary: Two orders would move money from Salary Reserve: $157,000 to accounts not named on the agenda, and $220,000 to Police Salaries.
items: Order 427-26: Transfer $157,000 from Salary Reserve (0010-996-5110) to the accounts listed in the order. Sponsor: Carey McDonald.
Order 428-26: Transfer $220,000 from Salary Reserve (0010-996-5110) to Police Salaries (0010-210-5120). Sponsor: Carey McDonald.
location: City Hall, Room 105, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA 02148
